context: Daichi and Sho discuss swimming in the pool.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: しょう、泳ぐ、本当、上手、なった。
lines.en: Sho, you've really gotten so good at swimming.
lines.style: Warm Kansai lilt threading through. Genuine pride in the opening—not performing, noticing. Soft, tender beat on his name. Real admiration, the kind that lands because it's specific.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: I'm trying hard every single day.
lines.style: Small, steady voice. No bragging. Just fact. Soft pride tucked underneath—he's telling Daichi because it matters to him what Daichi knows. Six-year-old sincerity, the kind that doesn't perform.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: It's really fun doing this together.
lines.style: Kansai warmth rolling through naturally. Not loud—intimate. The kind of contentment that doesn't need to announce itself. Genuine pleasure at the shared moment, soft and steady.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 友達、本当、いっぱい、いる。
lines.en: I have so many friends now.
lines.style: Small voice, surprised at his own good fortune. Not bragging—amazed. Like he's still getting used to the fact. Soft wonder underneath, six-year-old clarity about something that matters.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai warmth deepens. Closes on a note of genuine, unguarded happiness. Not loud, but full—the kind of tenderness that comes from seeing your kid become himself. Breath soft and satisfied.
